# Antik Surf Club

Antik Surf Club is a surf school and surf trip provider based in Asilah, Morocco.

## Website

- https://antiksurf.com

## Services

- Surf lessons
- Surf equipment rental
- Surf trips
- Surf experiences in Asilah, Morocco

- Surf trips: https://antiksurf.com/en/surftrips
